description: Use to see whether interest in a keyword is rising or falling week by week, how it splits across five stores, and which related searches go with it. Not for live search results (search) or a product's sales. A weekly snapshot of a cross-border search-interest proxy: what shoppers of one cross-border marketplace searched for on Amazon's US, UK, AE, IN and JP stores. A trend within that audience, not Amazon's own search volume and not live data. Price: $0.05 per answer. Keywords need at least 5 searches to be tracked. Paid data with no free calls. Over x402 you pay $0.05 per answer; when the data holds nothing for the input the answer is a 404 and the payment is NOT settled, so a miss costs nothing. With an API key an answer costs 10 requests and a 404 costs 1. Every answer carries `snapshot`: the weeks it covers, `trend_as_of` (the last complete week; later weeks are partial) and when it was built. Updated weekly.
